findings.title: UTC rollback revives expired runtime identity evidence
findings.verification: Executed targeted in-memory reproduction against hash-verified candidate net8.0 DLLs in PowerShell .NET 10.0.11; not an SDK 8 test rerun.
findings.problem: Freshness checks only now - observer.ObservedUtc. Expired evidence becomes Match again when UTC moves back within the original freshness window, even though monotonic elapsed time continues forward. HealthAdapterV1.cs:100-109 consumes that Match to reopen relevant NewEffect availability and potentially aggregate Healthy without a new observation.
findings.fix: Bind byte-load freshness to a monotonic elapsed timestamp from the observer-owned clock, retain UTC validation as metadata, and never revive an expired observation due to wall-clock rollback. Add a targeted identity plus relevant route regression; do not renew proof by hashing old bytes.
findings.missing_coverage: RuntimeIdentityTests.FreshnessIsEvaluatedOnEveryObservation only moves UTC forward. QualityBoundaryRegressionTests.HealthCacheExpiresByMonotonicTimeEvenWhenUtcMovesBackwards protects dependency caching, not identity.

findings.title: Set no-store on the new live and identity responses
findings.verification: Source-confirmed contract gap; no new HTTP execution for this finding.
findings.problem: Only startup/ready call Write(), which assigns Cache-Control:no-store at line 49. Live and identity return Results.Json directly with no equivalent header. In particular, a module identity Match response is allowed to be stored outside the adapter freshness check. The fixed OBS04-A4 health-output contract requires no-store; legacy responses already have it.
findings.repro: Start the authorized loopback fixture in HealthIdentityAndPermissionTests with MapCp6HealthV1; GET /ops/v1/live and /ops/v1/identity. Inspect response.Headers.CacheControl.NoStore: the candidate supplies no Cache-Control. Contrast /ops/v1/startup and /ops/v1/ready, which supply no-store. This reproduction is prescribed, not newly executed by this reviewer.
findings.fix: Apply no-store consistently to all four V1 operational response paths and add focused response-header assertions; preserve current authorization and wire shapes.
findings.missing_coverage: No task-private V1 test asserts Cache-Control. OBS04-A4 evidence maps hidden-aggregate output and a legacy endpoint test, so it does not verify these new direct-JSON routes.

targeted_execution.preceding_harness_failure: First in-memory Add-Type failed with CS1061 because inherited TimeProvider.System shadowed System.TimeSpan. Corrected the harness to global::System; no product source changed. This failure was not a candidate test failure.

limitations: The targeted reproduction used PowerShell .NET 10.0.11; required SDK8 regression remains with the implementer.
